Info: Machine translation This post was machine-translated from the Chinese original. Wording may be rough in places — the Chinese version is authoritative.

Summary Cycle quota, designated zero price, password-free queue, and community queues HyphenTech · Data and measurements from November 2, 2026

If you want a gadget to be accessible daily, first find a restorable quota or specify a zero-price model; If you just want to quickly verify an idea, you can also try the password-free entry point. This article places the collected periodic and password-free text solutions together, viewing them by access method, not by the “free” word on the flyer.

Groq, Gemini, and OpenRouter, which already have complete generated results, each have a test article beforehand. Agnes text also completed the order and rewrite, returning correctly twice, taking 4.264 seconds and 3.446 seconds respectively; By default, the trial phase discount and the image section share the same official website billing instructions. Here are the remaining directories: entries that did not receive this round of generated results will have their progress indicated. Data reference date is November 2, 2026.

Adding a newly established Agnes text interface

{
  "items": [
    {
      "name": "设备A",
      "quantity": 2,
      "unit_price": 1200,
      "subtotal": 2400
    },
    {
      "name": "设备B",
      "quantity": 3,
      "unit_price": 350,
      "subtotal": 1050
    }
  ],
  "shipping": 80,
  "discount": 130,
  "total": 3400
}

Agnes text returns to its original form

The request model is agnes-2.5-flash, with the text base address https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1. The above order contains the full field and is calculated at 3400 yuan; The Chinese rewrite also retains four pieces of information. Another old configuration in Agnes Text 2.0 returns 500, but no answer is found.

First, choose which free option you need

Designated models at zero price, like stores only offering products with event coupons for free; Cycle quotas, like monthly reissued trial coupons; Password-free services, like public queues where you can queue without a number. They address cost, trial, and access convenience respectively, and cannot add up credit units.

Demand Let’s first look at which category Priority checks
Organize small amounts of text every day Specify zero price/cycle quota Accurate modeling, reset, speed limiting
Temporary verification scripts Password-free/shared queues Wait, fail, and output match
Long-term access to products Formal services are permitted for the corresponding purpose Quota, permissions, and failure handling

Specify the model, account limit, and develop the free file

Zhipu Free Text Model (To Be Tested)

**Free cycles / Designated zero price. **Pricing list input and output are free; Fixed flow limit to account view.

Only specify Flash model; FlashX and flagship models are charged separately.

Models recorded in this edition: GLM-4.7-FLASH, GLM-4-FLASH-250414, GLM-Z1-FLASH.

https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4

Official portal: View Information.

Silicon-based flow-free models

**Free cycle / Designated zero price. **Free model bill is zero; Fixed rate limit based on specific model.

After real-name authentication, you can use all free models; You cannot count all images, videos, and audio models on the platform as free.

In this round of silicon-based requests, the 402 returned is the current account and the specified model, so it cannot be determined that all free models are invalid.

Test progress: Request sent: This account has returned 402 balance insufficient and no response received.

https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1

Official portal: View Information.

Modai API-Inference (to be tested)

**Periods are free / designated zero price. **Official offers free inference; The historical official announcement states 2,000 times per day; the current modal limit page is a dynamic page, so the full amount was not obtained this issue.

Use your own access token, and only select models with API-Inference services; Having a model repository does not mean the interface is open.

Official portal: View information 1; View information 2.

Mistral Free Development Mode (to be tested)

**Free cycle / Specified zero price. **Free mode includes monthly usage; Limits and rates are in the console.

The free mode allows you to create a key without needing a credit card; For per-model benefits, you need to check the Limits.

https://api.mistral.ai/v1

Official portal: View information 1; View information 2.

Cloudflare Text Inference (to be tested)

**Free cycles / designated zero price. **Share 10,000 Neurons daily; Not 10,000 times, nor 10,000 tokens.

Multi-modal consumption under the same account; Workers Free over-limit stopped, Workers Paid over-billing; Some cutting-edge models may require additional prepayment.

Model recorded in this edition: @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct.

Official portal: View Information.

Cloudflare Translation (to be tested)

**Free cycles / designated zero price. **Share 10,000 Neurons daily; Not 10,000 times, nor 10,000 tokens.

Multi-modal consumption under the same account; Workers Free over-limit stopped, Workers Paid over-billing; Some cutting-edge models may require additional prepayment.

The model recorded in this edition: @cf/meta/m2m100-1.2b.

Official portal: View information 1; View information 2.

iFlytek Spark Lite (to be tested)

**Cycle free / designated zero price. **HTTP documentation clearly states that the Lite lightweight model supports free use; Unified quota not obtained this period.

Requires corresponding HTTP permissions and APIPassword; WebSocket authentication cannot be applied.

Official portal: View Information.

AMD Token Factory text interface (to be tested)

**Daily quota for development purposes. **Free development services; Daily limit calculated based on points, reset at 00:00 Beijing time.

China site open; Does not consume cloud server credits; No resale allowed, not used for production.

https://developer.amd.com.cn/radeon/api/v1

Official portal: View information 1; View information 2.

Vercel AI Gateway Free Points (to be tested)

**Points awarded for periodic periods. **Each team receives $5 per month for free credits, applicable only to free tier subsets.

First request to start; After purchasing points, switch to paid tier; monthly free points no longer apply; Other modes cannot be supported by the platform to reverse free credits.

Official portal: View Information.

Pollinations Classic text (to be tested)

**No password-free data limits. **No registration; One request per IP address, with at least a 30-second interval.

Best effort service; Limit return 402 and Retry-After; Results of the same URL may share cache.

The model recorded in this edition: GPT-OSS 20B.

https://text.pollinations.ai

Official portal: View Information.

AI Horde Volunteer Shared Queue (to be tested)

**Community shared queues. **Volunteers share computing power, free text and image tasks; Queues and priorities vary with supply.

Use officially public APIs; Contributions and kudos influence priority; No commitment to fixed wait times or commercial licenses.

Official portal: View information 1; View information 2.

Turning directories into usable interfaces—how much step is needed?

First, create a key with your own account, select the exact model from the directory, and send a small task with a standard answer; Keep the status code, answer, actual model, and time spent. For example, this order question cost 3400 yuan, and the program can check directly. After mastering chat questions, test your abilities for reading, translation, and other abilities, without counting a single text answer as verified by the entire platform.

Cloudflare’s Neurons are units of usage calculated by model, more like the power consumed by different appliances; not the number of requests. Vercel’s points are shared wallets; As the number of models increases, wallets don’t add a few more accordingly. Moda’s model file pages and callable interfaces are also different, so you must find an open inference service.

Quote: My judgment First, find one entry point from the four tests that have completed similar tasks, then fill in the options according to this directory. Listing newly registered entries one by one at the end saves the time of “saving many addresses but not a single one is actually connected.”
